0022600220.text: The San Antonio Spurs (8-2, 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West) come in on an eight-game winning streak and are 4-0 on the road, while the Chicago Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East) have lost seven straight and are 0-3 at home. The Spurs are without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and the Bulls list Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness) as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Spurs swept both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 129-114 win over the Bulls in San Antonio on March 30.
